_comment: City structure catalogue for llm_city_builder. Add more entries to extend the city.

structures.label: One-Story House
structures.description: A single-floor residential building with 3-block walls, 1x2 door, windows, and flat roof.

structures.label: Two-Story House
structures.description: A residential building with two hollow 3-block floors, windows, solid intermediate floor at Layer 4, and flat roof.

structures.label: Shop
structures.description: A hollow commercial building with large glass display windows, 1x2 door, completely open interior, and flat roof.

structures.label: Church
structures.description: A tall place of worship with a high central nave, arched windows, and steeple.

structures.label: Park
structures.description: An open green space with dirt-with-grass ground, dirt paths, and a hollow perimeter fence frame.

structures.label: Watchtower
structures.description: A tall observation tower with solid intermediate floor slabs every 4 layers, hollow room interiors, and rooftop battlements.

structures.label: Skyscraper
structures.description: A tall modern high-rise tower with stone/brick framework, large glass window facades, solid intermediate floor slabs every 4 layers, hollow multi-floor interiors, and flat rooftop deck.

structures.label: House with Garden
structures.description: A single-story residential home with a flat roof and a hollow walkable grass garden with dirt paths on Layer 0 enclosed by a 1-block-wide perimeter fence frame on Layer 1.

structures.label: Two-Story House with Garden
structures.description: A two-story residential home with hollow floors, solid intermediate floor at Layer 4, flat roof, and a hollow walkable grass garden enclosed by a 1-block-wide perimeter fence frame on Layer 1.

structures.label: Town Hall
structures.description: A grand civic building with a large central entrance, columned facade, hollow interior rooms, and a central clock tower or dome on the roof.

structures.label: School
structures.description: A multi-room educational building with hollow classrooms, large glass windows, a central courtyard or playground path, and a flat roof.

structures.label: Library
structures.description: A quiet civic building with wood bookshelves along interior walls, open central reading area, large windows, and a flat roof.

structures.label: Hospital
structures.description: A large medical facility with a red cross emblem on a light stone facade, multiple hollow interior wards, emergency entrance, and a flat roof.

structures.label: Fire Station
structures.description: A functional civic building with large double-height bay doors for fire engines, watchtower shaft, hollow interior, and a flat roof.

structures.label: Police Station
structures.description: A secure civic building with reinforced stone/brick facade, holding cells, office area, hollow interior, and a flat roof.

structures.label: Apartment Building
structures.description: A residential high-rise with hollow rooms, solid intermediate floors every 4 layers, windows, balconies, and a flat rooftop deck.

structures.label: Factory
structures.description: An industrial building with a large open floor plan, hollow high-ceiling interior, smokestack pillars on the roof, and loading dock entrance.

structures.label: Water Tower
structures.description: An infrastructure tower featuring sturdy open support legs on lower layers supporting an elevated cylindrical water tank with a flat top.

structures.label: Restaurant
structures.description: A commercial dining building with large display windows, hollow dining room, outdoor patio seating area, and a flat roof.
